sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Jelly Gnam Gnam are straightforward yet engaging. Players control the Gnammy, a small jellyfish creature that swims through the ocean, collecting plankton while avoiding the red monsters. The game's primary objective is to gather as much plankton as possible, breaking your personal record with each new high score. To achieve this, players must navigate the Gnammy through the ocean, using their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to avoid obstacles and collect plankton.

As players progress through the game, they'll encounter various obstacles, including red monsters that will deduct one life if touched. Players must be careful and strategic in their movements to avoid these obstacles and collect as much plankton as possible. The game's speed and responsiveness make it challenging yet rewarding, and players will find themselves hooked as they try to beat their previous high scores.

One of the unique features of Jelly Gnam Gnam is its use of a red balloon, which occasionally appears in the game. Touching the red balloon earns a bonus, and players must be quick to grab it before it disappears. The game's core mechanics are simple yet engaging, making it accessible to a wide range of players. Whether you're a young child or an adult looking for a lighthearted experience, Jelly Gnam Gnam's gameplay is sure to captivate and entertain.
